ui.farm.block.no_stake_needed: This crop does not need a stake.
ui.farm.block.not_withered: The crop has not withered: wait for its season to pass, or harvest it.
ui.farm.block.stake_withered: A withered crop cannot be staked.
ui.farm.block.withered_care: The crop has withered: pull it up and take the by-product.
ui.farm.block.withered_harvest: {crop} has withered: it cannot be harvested, only pulled up.
ui.farm.hint.long_press: Tip: press and hold a crop to open the watering and manure menu.
ui.farm.label.withered: {crop} (withered: pull it up for a by-product)
ui.farm.note.last_picking: last picking: the plant has bolted; pulling it up gives seed
ui.farm.notice.frost: Frost struck: grown crops withered and seedlings were lost. Pulling up the withered ones gives a by-product.
ui.farm.notice.giant: A {crop} has grown in the field! It covers four tiles; harvesting it gives a large yield and a giant crop fit for display.
ui.farm.notice.season_soon: The season turns in two days: {n} crops are going out of season and will wither. Reap the ripe ones; a withered crop gives only a by-product.
ui.farm.notice.winter_soon: Winter is two days away: {n} crops in the field will not survive the frost. Reap the ripe ones; a grown crop withers when it freezes, and seedlings are lost.
ui.farm.notice.withered_season: Crops past their season have withered. A withered crop stops growing; pulling it up gives a by-product (seed, fodder, straw). Tap or drag to pull them up.
ui.farm.tip.giant: A ripe, watered 2×2 patch has a small chance of growing a giant crop
ui.farm.tip.perennial: Perennial bed: planted once, yields every year in season
ui.farm.tip.repeat: Pick-and-come-again: yields {n} times, then withers; pulling it up gives seed
ui.farm.tip.stake: Needs a stake (half yield without one)
